selection.policy: one SE; fewest mean selected encoded columns, then RMSE, then M0..M5

diagnostics.partition: Development training residuals, descriptive post-selection diagnostics
diagnostics.bp_method: Koenker/Breusch-Pagan n*R2 on squared residual auxiliary regression over full design column space; df=rank-1
diagnostics.bp_pvalue_note: Numerical underflow: stored 0.0 means below floating-point resolution, not an exactly zero probability
